To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have synthesized and characterized a diselenido-bridge dinuclear rutheniuim complex, [{Ru(P(OMe)(3))Cl}2(μ-Cl)(μ-Se-Se)] (1).
we report a diselenido-bridge dinuclear Ru(II) complex, [{Ru(II)Cl(P(OM e)3)2]2(μ-Se 2)(μ- Cl)2], which was synthesized from the reaction of trans-Ru(II)Cl2[P(OMe) 3]4 and red amorphus selenium.
we report the synthesis of the diselenido-bridge dinuclear ruthenum complex, [{Ru(Se2)2(μ-Se)2}2], and its electrochemistry.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation, structural characterization, and reactivity of the diselenido- and disulfido-bridged ruthenium complexes.
the synthesis and structural characterization of a diselenido-bridge dinuclear ruthenum complex.

the development of new synthetic methodology for the construction of diselenido- and diselenide-bridged dinucler complexes and their characterization by X-ray crystallography and electrochemical measurement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the diselenido complex is a good precursor for the synthesis of a disulfido complex.
the diselenido analogue is more stable than the disulfido one in the solid state, while the reverse is true in solution.
the title complex has the same structure as the disulfido complex but the Ru-Se and Se- Se bond lengths are longer than those in the corresponding disulfido complex.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the selenium atom is more easily oxidized than the sulfur atom, and that selenium is more easily substituted than sulfur.
the diselenido-bridge is more flexible than the disulfido one, but the Ru-Se bond is stronger than the Ru-S one.
the diselenido- and disulfido-bridged complexes show the similar reactivities and properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the selenium atoms in the diselenido-bridge are more reactive than the sulfur atoms in the disulfide analogue.
the diselenido-bridge is less stable than the disulfido bridge.
we can use a diselenido- or disulfido-bridged metal complex to synthesize a disulfide or diselenide.
